prompt: A young human wizard in a deep cerulean blue robe sits hunched at a cluttered oak desk, both hands cradling a glowing crystal scrying orb that shows a faint vision of a future tarot card swirling inside it. With his other gesture a worthless parchment scroll tumbles from his fingers toward the floor. The only source of light is the cold blue glow of the scrying orb on his face. The background is a dim study lined with bookshelves and stacked tomes.

A human wizard in sapphire blue robes stands at a candlelit desk, drawing a fresh glowing scroll from a tall stack of books with one hand while flinging a discarded scroll into a small brass brazier where it bursts into flame. His face is lit by the orange firelight of the brazier on one side and pale blue magic on the other. The background is a cramped wizards study with shelves of leather-bound tomes.

Wide interior view of a dim library. An old human wizard in indigo robes leans over a wooden table, a large crystal scrying ball glowing blue at the center, several tarot cards fanned out across the table. One card at the table edge has caught fire and curls into ash. The only source of light is the blue glow of the crystal ball spilling across scattered scrolls. The background is towering bookshelves fading into shadow.

Close three-quarter view of a human wizard in cerulean blue robes, eyes wide and reflecting a glowing playing card hovering in the air before his face, its surface bright with magical light revealing a future card. His other hand lets a dull grey discarded card slip away into shadow below. The only source of light is the glowing card hovering at his face. The background is a shadowy study with a sliver of bookshelf.

A young apprentice wizard in a worn blue tunic peers intently into a shallow silver scrying bowl filled with glowing water that shows a rippling vision. Beside the bowl a small pile of crumpled rejected scrolls lies on the desk. His face is lit pale blue from below by the glowing water. The background is a candlelit alcove with a single window and shelves of jars and books.

A robed human wizard in deep blue reaches one arm into a glowing arcane bookshelf, pulling out a single luminous tome, while behind him a discarded book tumbles off the shelf into darkness. Cold blue mana light glows from the bookshelf onto his face and outstretched arm. The background is a vast dim arcane library receding into shadow.

Side profile of a stern human wizard in wine-blue robes seated at a desk, gazing into a floating constellation of glowing blue runes that form a vision of the future above an open book. With his far hand he flicks a discarded card off the desk edge toward the floor. The only source of light is the constellation of blue runes. The background is a moonlit study with a tall arched window.

A human wizard in cerulean robes hunched over a desk cradling a glowing crystal orb in both hands, peering into a swirling future vision inside it, his spectacles glinting with the blue light. Loose scrolls and a quill clutter the desk, one scroll half-fallen over the edge. The only source of light is the crystal orb glowing blue on his face and hands. The background is a cozy cluttered study with bookshelves.

Overhead view looking down at a wizards desk: a pair of blue-sleeved hands cradle a glowing crystal scrying orb showing a future card vision, while one hand sweeps a discarded grey card off the desk into shadow. Scattered tarot cards and an open spellbook surround the orb. The only source of light is the orb glowing blue across the desk. The background is dark wooden floorboards below the desk edge.

A human wizard in a deep blue hooded robe stands holding a glowing tarot card up to one eye, reading its bright magical vision, while his other hand tosses a dull discarded card downward where it spins away. Cold blue light from the held card illuminates his face and hood. The background is a dim arcane chamber with a glowing rune circle on the floor and shelves of books.
